source_text:
Synthetic validation nurse note. No real patient data.

The driver had transient loss of consciousness while seated after a delivery, with a colleague documenting failure to respond and a brief gap in recall. The current physician referral states that the mechanism is under investigation. An emergency differential mentions arrhythmia and seizure without confirming either, and a glucose measurement obtained after food cannot establish the cause of the event.

The optometrist confirms a visual field defect on a separate current signed assessment. The driver describes occasionally noticing vehicles late on the left, although central letters remain clear; a specialist has not yet documented whether the defect is stable, its complete binocular horizontal extent or whether other significant field loss is present.

An older report described satisfactory central acuity, but the nurse has not used it to overrule the newer field finding. The driver is unsure whether a remote dizzy spell involved loss of awareness, so the number of confirmed events and the appropriate event-free interval remain unresolved despite documentation of the recent event and the visual field defect.
